description: Move a Task of a claimed Goal to another Goal when it belongs there. It keeps its title, summary, files and state, gets a new ID at the end of the other Goal's list (or right before or after the Task given in before or after) and a 'moved from' line. In the old Goal it stays as a dropped Task whose reason is where it went, so refs and history still work. The other Goal must not be dropped, done or held by another running Session; a Task in progress can move only if the other Goal has none in progress.

after.description: A Task ID in the other Goal to put it behind.

before.description: A Task ID in the other Goal to put it in front of.

goal.description: The claimed Goal the Task is in. Needed only when this Session holds several Goals.

to_goal.description: The ID of the Goal to move the Task to.

name: move_task
title: Move Task
